_status: v4 - owner accepted the defaults ('go, use the defaults') after four review rounds. Still traced by eye from the imagery, so positions are +/- a few metres. Input for the carved terrain: project/scripts/water_data.gd is generated from this file by tools/build_water_data.py.
_crs: scene meters, +X east, +Z south, origin at the parcel centroid (D-6)
_how_to_review: python3 tools/water_overlay.py  (draws this file over the imagery with numbered vertices); correct by vertex id, e.g. 'D7 -> (251, 12)', then python3 tools/build_water_data.py
_units: dimensions are the owner's figures converted from feet, midpoint of the stated range
_v7_changes: pond shrunk and an overflow built (D-172): the north shore of the west lobe is cut back to the owner's line from (-12.8, 11.0) to (-43.6, 4.0), wavy rather than straight (pond.cut_north_shore, read east to west, applied only between its first and last x); the pond spills at its start (-50.1, 2.5) into an open overflow channel that runs to (-74.6, 21.1), goes through a 11 m culvert under the fenced track, then sweeps in a big curve south-west to the back property line near (-133.5, 182). Water runs in it only while the pond is spilling
_v6_changes: pond enlarged a little more (D-169): half-widths up 1-2.5 m under the trees, most at the north-east end (x 96-131); west tip unchanged; then the spine point at x=119 moved north to z -6 with half-width 14 so the full pond reaches (121.2, -16.5) (owner, from the full-pond aerials); pond depth 3.8 -> 4.3 m and bank run 9 -> 7.5 m for a deeper, flatter floor with steeper (max ~41 deg) sides
_v5_changes: pond enlarged (D-153): the rim now sits just inside the tree line in the aerial imagery all round (west lobe, south bank, east tip) and 6-8 m out on the open meadow to the north of the east half; the west tip stays at x~-54 so the track's inner fence still stands on level ground
_v4_changes: south run re-routed after checking the scene fences: the fence line is at z~67 (not 63), so east of x~140 the ditch runs on the bare brown strip just south of it (z~69.5) and crosses the track team corner at x~135-140 to run inside the triangle at z~66.4; it ends at x=67. Fence posts follow the carved ground, so a post at a crossing stands in the channel
driveway culvert ends moved to z -54 / -39.5 (clear of the driveway fence post at (258.6,-52.2))
pond west tip pulled in to x~-55 so the track's inner fence (x -50..-60, z 0..5) stays on level ground; the middle-west lobe is wider to compensate
buried pipe bends: west along z=66.4 to x=59.4, then straight north
profile parameters added: ditch top width 2.7 m / bottom 0.4 m, pond bank run 9 m
_v3_changes: pond extended east to x~131 (owner: almost 130, a little farther)
ditch is mostly straight along the south fence line from the road westward
two buried sections: a culvert at the driveway, then a pipe from the track team triangle's tip (where it becomes the narrow track, x~65) north to the pond inlet at x=59.4
_v2_changes: ditch moved east: ~x=259.5 from the weir to the driveway, ~x=255 south of it (the brown band)
ditch goes underground (buried pipe/culvert) on its way to the pond
pond made larger to the west
brighter green in the imagery is dried-out pond vegetation, so the bright-green bowl and the pale NE strip are pond bed

weir.note: NE corner of the parcel at the road

ditch.depth_note: 2-3 ft stated by owner, midpoint 2.5 ft
ditch.width_note: top-of-bank width. NOT stated by the owner. The first guess (1.5 m) made the banks steeper than the 45 degrees a player can climb out of, so the default is 2.7 m (banks ~40 degrees). The brown band beside the road is ~4-6 m wide.

segments.name: culvert under the driveway
segments.note: owner confirmed the grey strip is the driveway; the open ditch stops a little short of it on each side (z -54 / -39.5)

segments.name: south of the driveway, along the road (browner)
west along the south fence line, mostly straight, through the track team triangle
segments.note: owner: from the road westward it is mostly straight along the fence line. East of x~140 it runs on the bare brown strip just south of the fence (fence at z~67, property line at z~71.2); it then crosses the fence corner into the track team triangle and runs inside it at z~66.4, ending at x=67 just short of the track fence ends (x~64.6)

segments.name: buried pipe from the track start, west then straight north into the pond at x=59.4
segments.note: owner: underground where the triangular paddock goes into the long narrow track; enters the pond 2 ft (0.6 m) west of x=60 and runs straight north. Not carved into the terrain.

pond.depth_note: owner wrote '10-15' (read as feet of depth); midpoint 12.5 ft
pond.bank_run_note: horizontal distance over which the bank falls from the rim to full depth (steepest ~32 degrees); narrow necks are shallower because they are narrower than two runs
pond.shape_note: long three-lobed peanut, NE to W, larger to the west; bright green areas are dried-out pond bed; spine with half-width at each point, drawn as a union of tapered circles
pond.cut_north_shore_note: the owner's new north shore of the west lobe, east to west, from (-12.8, 11.0) to (-43.6, 4.0) but wavy, not straight; the pond is only the ground south of this line. It starts at (-8, 13.2) and ends at the overflow's start (-50.1, 2.5), both on the old rim, so the shore has no step. It cuts only between its first and last x.

overflow.note: where a full pond spills (D-172): water runs here only while the pond is at its spill level with water still coming in. Same channel as the ditch (depth, widths); carved where open.

segments.name: open channel from the pond's west tip to the track's inner fence
segments.note: owner: starts at (-50.1, 2.5), then (-52.3, 2.1), then straight to (-74.6, 21.1)

segments.name: culvert under the fenced track
segments.note: continues the line of the channel for 11.3 m, under the track's inner fence, the lane and the outer fence (outer fence is about 6 m along)

segments.name: big curve south-west to the back property line
segments.note: owner: follows a big curve toward the back of the property line in a south-westerly direction. A 100 m radius arc turns the channel from south-west to south-south-west, then it runs straight to the property line at z~184 (2 m inside it). It passes about 7 m east of the Southwest Pasture teleport pad (-115, 60).
